_readme: Dock season status for water.html#docks. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build-docks.py && python3 tools/stamp-version.py. Status is one of: in, ending, out, unannounced. 'ending' needs 'ends' (YYYY-MM-DD) and flips to 'after' text on the page once that date passes. Never set 'out' without an official source saying so. 'checked' is the date someone last read every source below. tools/check-docks.py watches the 'watch' list.

hoover.name: Hoover

items.name: Public boat dock rentals
items.label: Through Oct. 31
items.note: Columbus lists public boat dock rentals at Hoover from May 1 to Oct. 31. Those dates are the rental season. They are not a report that the docks left the water.
items.after_note: Public boat dock rentals at Hoover ran May 1 to Oct. 31, so the rental season is closed. The rental calendar is not a report of which docks are in the water.

items.name: Marina and courtesy docks
items.label: Not confirmed
items.note: Whether the marina docks and the public launch courtesy docks are in the water is unconfirmed. City alerts have no current confirmation of a pull. The lack of an alert is not evidence the docks are in. ODNR says Columbus maintains the docks and does not report whether they are in now. An open ramp does not mean a dock is installed.
